outcome: age at passage of the first meconium (PoFM)
cohort: The study included 800 neonates (38 with Hirschsprung's disease and 762 non-HD) selected from Siriraj Hospital between January 2000 and December 2022.
finding: The median age of passage of first meconium (PoFM) was similar between neonates with Hirschsprung's disease (10.5 hours) and those without (8.0 hours), with 89.5% of HD patients passing their first meconium within 24 hours.
